title: Gate VCF deployment on the Installer precheck
prompt:
Implement `src/VcfInstallerClient.java`, a dependency-free, single-file Java 17 client for the pinned VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 Installer REST contract in `docs/contract.json`. The public records and method signatures in the starter file are fixed. `precheckThenDeploy` must serialize the supplied SDDC specification, submit `validateSddcSpec`, poll `getSddcSpecValidation` only while the validation is non-terminal, and call `deploySddc` only after the validation has executionStatus `COMPLETED` and resultStatus `SUCCEEDED`. A terminal non-success must return a non-deployed outcome. Exhaustion of exactly the configured number of poll attempts, or an unexpected validation or polling HTTP response, must throw `IOException` without a subsequent deployment request. A successful outcome must contain the final validation id and result status plus the deployment response's task id.

Send exactly one Bearer authorization header and `Accept: application/json` on every request. Send `Content-Type: application/json` on the two body-bearing POST requests and not on polling GET requests. Use compact JSON with no insignificant whitespace. Serialize top-level members in this order: `sddcId`, `workflowType` when present, `version` when present, `vcenterSpec`, `networkSpecs`, and `dnsSpec`. Within `vcenterSpec`, use `vcenterHostname`, `rootVcenterPassword`, `vmSize` when present, then `storageSize` when present. Within each network object, use `networkType` then `vlanId`; within `dnsSpec`, use `subdomain` then `nameservers` when present. Preserve list order and correctly JSON-escape runtime strings. Reuse the exact request body bytes for validation and deployment.

Optional SDDC properties whose values are null and the optional deploy query parameter `skipValidations` when null must be omitted, never represented as empty strings, null JSON values, or an empty query value. Non-null optional properties must be serialized with their supplied values. A non-null `skipValidations` must be sent as the lowercase boolean query `skipValidations=true` or `skipValidations=false`. Use only the Java standard library and do not contact a live VMware endpoint.

Do not edit the protected harness, mock, contract, or provenance files. The provided loopback mock is contract-pinned and its request log is checked for exact method, path, query, headers, body bytes, polling order, immediate-terminal behavior, and the no-mutation-on-failed-precheck guarantee. Run `python3 tests/verify.py` to verify the implementation.
description: Implement the dependency-free Java 17 VCF Installer client and gate deployment on a successful terminal SDDC validation.
scenario: An SDDC specification is validated and polled to a terminal result; deployment occurs only for COMPLETED and SUCCEEDED validation.
constraints: Use only the Java standard library and keep the implementation in src/VcfInstallerClient.java.
Do not contact a live VMware endpoint.
Omit null optional request properties and omit skipValidations when it is null.
Never call deploySddc after a failed, non-terminally exhausted, or HTTP-failed precheck.
